source.title: Limited Resources 872 — Reality Fracture Set Review: Commons and Uncommons

cards.name: Academic Ascent
cards.oracle_text:
Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains flying until end of turn.
Empower Jace 2. (Put two loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: 2-mana +2/+2 flying trick that also builds Jace, underwhelming as just a pump spell.

cards.name: Blossom-Blessed Angel // Seed Suture
cards.oracle_text:
Blossom-Blessed Angel — Flying, vigilance
This creature enters prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
//
Seed Suture — Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. You gain 1 life.
cards.note: Ludicrous rate (2/4 flying vigilance) for a common, plus a strong Seed Suture back half.

cards.name: Campus Crier
cards.oracle_text: {1}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Empower Jace 2. (Put two loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: 2-mana 3/1 that can later exile from the graveyard to add loyalty to Jace.

cards.name: Danitha, Sword of Hope
cards.oracle_text:
First strike
Whenever you cast an Equipment spell or a spell that targets a creature you control, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.note: 2/2 first strike drawing a card once per turn off equipment or own-creature spells; better once it gets a counter.

cards.name: Fateshaper Aspirant
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Return target legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains vigilance and indestructible until end of turn. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)
cards.note: Grade slides with how many legendary targets you have to return from the graveyard.

cards.name: Generous Revival
cards.oracle_text:
Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Flashback {4}{W} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
cards.note: Returns a cheap creature with a +1/+1 counter and has flashback; needs enough good 3-drops to be worth it.

cards.name: Ghalta the Immovable
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the greatest toughness among creatures you control.
Creatures you control can attack as though they didn't have defender.
Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
cards.note: Needs a 4-5 toughness creature on board to become an affordable 7/7; risky if that creature gets removed.

cards.name: Graft Surgeon
cards.oracle_text:
This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When this creature dies, put its counters on up to one target creature you control.
cards.note: 3-mana 3/3 that redistributes its counters to another creature when it dies.

cards.name: Hexhaven Battalion
cards.oracle_text:
Create three 2/2 colorless Wizard Soldier creature tokens named Cadet. Empower Jace 2. (Put two loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
Basic landcycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.)
cards.note: Basic-land-cyclable sorcery that makes three 2/2s and a Jace; a board state in a box.

cards.name: Koth of the Homestead
cards.oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life.
Whenever a Plains you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
cards.note: Landfall lifegain plus a +1/+1 counter per Plains, snowballs easily without costing anything.

cards.name: Memory Trap
cards.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
cards.note: Reprint of the exile-until-leaves-play enchantment effect, a reliable format all-star.

cards.name: Predictive Preparations
cards.oracle_text:
Put a +1/+1 counter on each of one or two target creatures.
Flashback {3}{W} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
cards.note: Needs counter synergies to shine; otherwise just a modest double-pump spell with flashback.

cards.name: Prophesied End
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature. If it wasn't attacking, its controller draws a card.
cards.note: Great if it only ever kills attackers, but forced non-attacker kills let the opponent draw a card.

cards.name: Refute Destiny
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature or planeswalker that's green or blue. Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
cards.note: Green/blue-hosing exile effect, dead in best-of-1 but strong to bring in against those colors.

cards.name: Rescue Girl, First Responder
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
{T}: Return another target permanent you control to its owner's hand. Activate only during your turn.
cards.note: 1/3 flyer that bounces your own permanents for ETB value and can even rebounce a land for extra mana.

cards.name: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you scry or surveil, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.note: Turns any scry or surveil, including a Jace's minus ability, into a free flying Thopter token.

cards.name: Shatterwing Pegasus
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
{4}{W}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
cards.note: Fits a flyers or go-wide deck but power level isn't quite high enough to overcome the synergy dependence.

cards.name: Surgical Precision
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater. You gain 1 life.
• You draw a card and gain 2 life.
cards.note: Modal kill-a-big-creature or cantrip common with no real downside.

cards.name: Teyo, Lightshield Expert
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
When Teyo enters, target permanent you control gains hexproof until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature. Put a loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
cards.note: 2-mana 1/1 flash that grants hexproof plus a permanent counter, protecting a creature while adding stats.

cards.name: Thalia, the Survivor
cards.oracle_text:
Lifelink
Noncreature spells your opponents cast cost {1} more to cast.
cards.note: Great body (3/4 lifelink) that taxes opponents' noncreature spells and benefits from +1/+1 counters.

cards.name: Tomik, Orzhov Lawmage
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Planeswalkers you control have "No more than one creature can attack this planeswalker each combat."
{T}: Target creature with a +1/+1 counter on it gains flying until end of turn.
cards.note: 2-mana 2/1 flyer with niche upside protecting Jace and enabling +1/+1 counter synergies.

cards.name: Unflinching Hortimancer
cards.oracle_text:
Ward {1} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {1}.)
Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.note: 2-mana 2/1 Ward 1 that grows with lifegain, a nice payoff for the lifegain sub-theme.

cards.name: Way of the Healer
cards.oracle_text:
When Way of the Healer enters, empower Jace 5. (Put five loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
Planeswalkers you control have "[−2]: Create a 2/2 colorless Wizard Soldier creature token named Cadet. Surveil 1."
cards.note: Almost always nets a 2/2 token, a 3-loyalty Jace, and a Surveil for 4 mana.

cards.name: Way of the Mentor
cards.oracle_text:
When Way of the Mentor enters, empower Jace 5. (Put five loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
Whenever you gain life, put a loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control.
cards.note: Needs a life-gain shell to turn loyalty gains into real value; weak as your first big play of the game.

cards.name: Yoshimaru, Beloved Companion
cards.oracle_text:
If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
{6}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target legendary creature.
cards.note: Explosive counter-doubling engine that pairs well with other 3-mana legends like Koth and Danitha.

cards.name: Your Fate Ends Here
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature or planeswalker with mana value 3 or greater. Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
cards.note: A really solid removal spell; the mana-value-3-or-greater restriction favors killing the bigger threat anyway.

cards.name: Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty
cards.oracle_text:
During combat, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.
Whenever a creature you control attacks a player alone, it gains double strike until end of turn.
cards.note: High-variance card: huge upside if it survives and attacks, but a 4-mana 2/3 is a blowout when answered.

cards.name: Arni, Humble Scribe
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, untap Arni.
{T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.note: Free looter that untaps whenever you play a nontoken creature, though it dies easily at 2 toughness.

cards.name: Countersculpt
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, behold a Jace or pay {1}. (To behold a Jace, choose a Jace you control or reveal a Jace card from your hand.)
Counter target spell. Empower Jace 1. (Put a loyalty counter on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: Essentially Cancel with a Surveil or bonus loyalty upside via Behold a Jace.

cards.name: Cryotheory Adept
cards.oracle_text:
Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
{3}{U}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Tap target creature and put a stun counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
cards.note: 2/1 prowess is mediocre as a beatdown plan, though the graveyard tap ability adds some value.

cards.name: Divining Duelist
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Tap target creature.
• Untap target creature.
• Draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.note: Flexible flash creature that taps/untaps a creature or loots, a fine if unexciting playable.

cards.name: Fblthp, Impossibly Lost
cards.oracle_text: When one or more of your opponents are dealt combat damage during your turn, draw two cards. If your library has no cards in it, you win the game. Fblthp's owner shuffles him into their library. (If you draw from an empty library this way, you still win the game.)
cards.note: Cool alternate win condition (graded build-around A+), but as a functional card it needs you to already be hitting your opponent.

cards.name: Geist of Saint Thalia
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Noncreature spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
cards.note: At 2 mana the noncreature-spell cost discount is strong enough to build a deck around.

cards.name: Hapatra, the Desert Frost
cards.oracle_text:
When Hapatra enters, for each opponent, tap up to one target creature that player controls. Put a stun counter on each of those creatures. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
{2}{U}: Untap target creature.
cards.note: 4-mana 4/3 that taps and stuns an opponent's creature on entry, plus a repeatable untap ability.

cards.name: Icy Reception
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Counter target creature or legendary spell unless its controller pays {3}.
• Target creature gets -5/-0 until end of turn.
cards.note: Twist on Essence Scatter that also hits legendary spells or shrinks a creature, useful to trigger prowess.

cards.name: Infinite Coursework
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature. It becomes unprepared.
Enchanted creature loses all abilities and doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
cards.note: Solid blue removal that taps a creature and strips its abilities so it can't untap.

cards.name: Mindseeker Oculus
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, empower Jace 4. (Put four loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: 3-mana 2/1 that draws a card and leaves behind an Empower Jace 4 token, huge value for a common.

cards.name: Perfected Theory
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature has base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
• Target creature has base power and toughness 4/5 until end of turn.
cards.note: Flexible power/toughness-setting instant, but this style of effect tends not to play out well.

cards.name: Plan for All Outcomes
cards.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, the owner of up to one other target nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
Whenever you cast your first noncreature spell each turn, empower Jace 1. (Put a loyalty counter on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: Sorcery-speed tuck effect on a permanent that keeps generating Empower Jace value off your first noncreature spell each turn.

cards.name: Precise Redaction
cards.oracle_text: Counter target white or black spell.
cards.note: Narrow counterspell that only hits white or black spells, best kept in the sideboard.

cards.name: Proft, Consulting Detective
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you scry or surveil, you may pay {2}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on Proft and draw a card. (Draw after you scry or surveil.)
cards.note: Strong scry/surveil payoff for counters and cards, but value depends on how much scry/surveil support you have.

cards.name: Protege's Awakening
cards.oracle_text:
Empower Jace 6. (Put six loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
Draw a card.
cards.note: 4-mana draw 2 that can become a draw 3 if the leftover Jace token survives to be used.

cards.name: Ruric Thar, Biomagus
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Prowess, prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn twice.)
Whenever Ruric Thar becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, draw a card.
cards.note: 6-mana 4/6 flying double-prowess finisher that draws a card when targeted, but still a costly card to lose.

cards.name: Semester Foreseer // Peer Review
cards.oracle_text:
Semester Foreseer — This creature enters prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
When this creature enters, surveil 1.
//
Peer Review — Create a 2/2 colorless Wizard Soldier creature token named Cadet. Surveil 1.
cards.note: Called a rock-solid playable 4-mana 3/4 with surveil and a strong flashback spell, but the transcript's grade line is garbled/overlapping and no clear letter is stated.

cards.name: Sphinx's Approach
cards.oracle_text:
Draw two cards. Then you may exile this spell and four cards named Sphinx's Approach from your graveyard. If you do, search your library for a Sphinx creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
A deck can have any number of cards named Sphinx's Approach.
cards.note: Card-disadvantage draw-2 whose bonus mode needs 4 copies plus a Sphinx in play, too slow and cute for limited.

cards.name: Surveillance Phantasm
cards.oracle_text:
Defender, flying, vigilance
As long as you've scried or surveilled this turn, this creature can attack as though it didn't have defender.
{3}{U}: Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
cards.note: Efficient 2-mana 2/3 flying defender that can attack and gives you a way to surveil if needed.

cards.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
cards.oracle_text: Creatures you control with power or toughness 1 or less can't be blocked.
cards.note: Makes small creatures unblockable and has historically overperformed in aggro decks full of 1-toughness bodies.

cards.name: Traxos, Academy Guardian
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {2} less to cast if you've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
Flying, vigilance
Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
cards.note: 1/5 flying vigilance with prowess that can cost as little as 2 mana after casting a noncreature spell.

cards.name: Undulating Witness
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
{2}: This creature gets +1/-1 until end of turn.
Basic landcycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.)
cards.note: Big 3/5 flyer for 5 mana with a small pump ability, comparable to the set's basic landcyclers.

cards.name: Unsummon
cards.oracle_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
cards.note: Cheap, efficient bounce that's especially good against tokens and can save your own creature.

cards.name: Way of the Cryomancer
cards.oracle_text:
When Way of the Cryomancer enters, empower Jace 5. (Put five loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
Planeswalkers you control have "[−3]: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy."
cards.note: Empowers Jace and lets a loyalty ability copy your next spell, but Jace's built-in -3 already does more.

cards.name: Way of the Mind Sculptor
cards.oracle_text:
When Way of the Mind Sculptor enters, empower Jace 5. (Put five loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
Whenever you activate a loyalty ability, if you removed two or more loyalty counters to activate it, draw a card.
cards.note: Draws 2 cards and leaves a 2-loyalty Jace, best in decks that keep triggering loyalty abilities that remove 2+ counters.

cards.name: Yargle, Goliath of Otaria
cards.note: Luis: matchup-dependent, great vs. red-green but a C/C- overall and a sideboard card; Marshall floated D or F for the maindeck without settling.

cards.name: Yuriko, Hope from the Shadows
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
When Yuriko enters, choose one —
• Target creature gets -X/-0 until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your graveyard.
• Surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
cards.note: 1-mana flash 1/1 with a flexible ETB (shrink an attacker or Surveil 2), close to a full card's worth of value.

cards.name: Apex Witchstalker
cards.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
When this creature enters or dies, you gain 2 life.
Basic landcycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.)
cards.note: A big menace body that can gain 4 life across its lifecycle, fills black's aggressive-green-creature slot.

cards.name: Break Under Pressure
cards.oracle_text: Target opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker with the greatest mana value among creatures and planeswalkers they control. You gain 2 life.
cards.note: Forces the sacrifice of an opponent's best permanent and gains 2 life, a great and reliable effect.

cards.name: Cast Away Doubt
cards.oracle_text: Draw two cards. Cast Away Doubt deals 2 damage to each player.
cards.note: Good for aggressive red-black, black-green, and black-white decks; worse in blue-black which doesn't want to pay life to draw.

cards.name: Danitha, Spear of Agony
cards.oracle_text:
First strike
Whenever you cast a spell that targets an opponent or a creature an opponent controls, put a +1/+1 counter on Danitha.
cards.note: Cheap first striker that only needs one targeted spell to become a 3/3, and black has plenty of removal to trigger it.

cards.name: Extended Absence
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature or planeswalker. Extended Absence deals 1 damage to each opponent and you gain 1 life.
cards.note: Premium exile removal that also pings for 1 and gains a life, strong in every deck.

cards.name: Gallia, Tragic Host
cards.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
{4}{B}, Exile another creature card from your graveyard: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on her.
cards.note: 2-mana 2/1 menace that can recur itself from the graveyard for 5 mana plus a counter, hard to keep down.

cards.name: Last Gasp
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
cards.note: Efficient reprint removal, -3/-3 for 2 mana that consistently trades up.

cards.name: Loot, the Anomaly
cards.oracle_text:
If Loot's power is negative, he assigns combat damage as though his power were positive.
Threshold — Sacrifice another creature or planeswalker: Loot gets -2/-0 until end of turn. Activate only if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
cards.note: Threshold-gated sacrifice outlet is unreliable and the set doesn't support a sacrifice deck enough to make it good.

cards.name: Mabel, Bitter Recluse
cards.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
When Mabel enters, remove up to three counters from another target creature or planeswalker.
cards.note: 1-mana 1/1 deathtouch that strips counters, especially good at killing Jace planeswalker tokens.

cards.name: Massacre Girl, Most Wanted
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever another creature or planeswalker you control dies, Massacre Girl deals 1 damage to target opponent and you gain 1 life.
Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, put a +1/+1 counter on Massacre Girl.
cards.note: A huge threat that punishes opponents whenever your creatures or planeswalkers die, dangerous if it survives removal.

cards.name: Multiply by Zero
cards.oracle_text: Target creature has base power and toughness 0/0 until end of turn.
cards.note: 2-mana instant-speed removal setting power/toughness to 0/0, blanked only by +1/+1 counters.

cards.name: Proft, Sinister Mastermind
cards.oracle_text:
Threshold — You can't cast this spell unless there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Menace
{B}, Discard this card: Target creature gets -3/-1 until end of turn.
cards.note: Even without threshold it doubles as a fine removal spell, and once enabled it's a cheap 5/5 menace.

cards.name: Rampart Hunter
cards.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
When this creature enters, target creature gets +2/+2 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
cards.note: A clean, on-color effect but just not powerful enough to matter.

cards.name: Rank Rat
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card.
cards.note: 1-mana 1/1 that makes the opponent discard, a reliably solid Ravenous Rats variant.

cards.name: Rewrite Regrets
cards.oracle_text:
Return target creature or planeswalker card with mana value 6 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Empower Jace 2. (Put two loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: Reanimation plus empower 2 is good value, especially with self-mill support fueling the graveyard.

cards.name: Screeching Soulbreaker
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to each opponent and you gain 1 life.
cards.note: A 3-mana 1/4 flyer that pings for 2 and gains a life on attack is solid value.

cards.name: Silence the Echo
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or planeswalker or pay {3}.
Destroy target creature or planeswalker.
cards.note: 5-mana sorcery-speed removal that drops to 2 mana if you sacrifice a creature or planeswalker.

cards.name: Solve for Disappointment
cards.oracle_text:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland permanent card from it. That player discards that card.
Empower Jace 1. (Put a loyalty counter on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: Missing the discard turns a cheap edict-style effect into a disaster, best against decks with big permanents.

cards.name: Terminal Criticism
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature or planeswalker that's blue or red. You gain 1 life.
cards.note: Solid removal but color-restricted to blue or red, so it's mainly a sideboard card.

cards.name: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
When Teyo enters, target permanent you control gains deathtouch until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature. Put a loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker.
cards.note: Flash deathtouch/counter is fine but a 3/1 body for 4 mana underwhelms.

cards.name: Theoretical Necromancer
cards.oracle_text: {3}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.note: Dies easily and the 4-mana Raise Dead ability is expensive, feels unpushed on both ends.

cards.name: Tinybones, Pocket Nuisance
cards.oracle_text:
When Tinybones enters, each opponent discards a card.
Whenever a player discards one or more cards, Tinybones deals 1 damage to each opponent.
cards.note: A better body than the 1-mana discard rat, trades with real creatures and pings repeatedly on future discards.

cards.name: Void Extrapolator // Omit Variables
cards.oracle_text:
Void Extrapolator — This creature enters prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
Threshold — This creature gets +1/+1 as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
//
Omit Variables — Mill three cards. (Put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard.)
cards.note: Efficient 2-mana 2/2 with Threshold upside, best as an enabler in blue-black self-mill.

cards.name: Way of the Deathbringer
cards.oracle_text:
When Way of the Deathbringer enters, empower Jace 5. (Put five loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
Planeswalkers you control have "[−2]: You may sacrifice a creature. If you do, create a 4/4 green Beast creature token with trample."
cards.note: Replaces itself and can upgrade a bad creature into a 4/4, but only a good deal with expendable sacrifice fodder.

cards.name: Way of the Necromancer
cards.oracle_text:
When Way of the Necromancer enters, empower Jace 2. (Put two loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
Whenever a creature you control dies, put a loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control.
cards.note: Only good if heavily invested in the empower/loyalty-counter theme, mediocre otherwise.

cards.name: Winter, Tormented Loner
cards.oracle_text:
When Winter enters, you may sacrifice a creature or planeswalker. When you do, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
Winter gets +1/+0 for each creature and planeswalker card in your graveyard.
cards.note: At worst an Edict effect; good if you have sacrifice fodder like small tokens, mediocre without it.

cards.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
cards.note: The reprinted vanilla giant doesn't play well without evasion or protection.

cards.name: Arni, Renowned Champion
cards.oracle_text:
Trample
Whenever another creature you control enters, Arni gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is that creature's power.

cards.note: 5-mana 3/3 that shrinks a creature based on the highest mana value in the graveyard, reliably strong.

cards.name: Primal Witchstalker
cards.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
When this creature enters, mill four cards. When you do, return target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. (To mill four cards, put the top four cards of your library into your graveyard.)
cards.note: 2/1 menace that mills 4 and returns a land to the battlefield, a strong 3-drop.

cards.name: Charge the Sanctum
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
• Target creature gets +2/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.note: Expensive but powerful combat trick that can pump the team or give first strike plus a counter.

cards.name: Mabel, Valley Hero
cards.oracle_text: Whenever Mabel or another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature that entered this turn.
cards.note: Comes down as a 2/3 that gives every entering creature an extra counter, seen as a must-kill threat.

cards.name: Warrior's Blades
cards.oracle_text:
When this Equipment enters, it deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
Equipped creature gets +2/+1.
Equip {3}. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each +1/+1 counter on the creature it targets.
cards.note: Equipment that enters like a Lightning Helix, then leaves behind solid +2/+1 equipment.

cards.name: Kiora of Salt and Sand
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever you attack, if you've activated a loyalty ability this turn, untap target attacking creature. It can't be blocked this turn.
Planeswalkers you control have "[−8]: Create an 8/8 blue Leviathan creature token with hexproof."
cards.note: Build-around that turns empowered Jace loyalty into an unblockable attack and an 8/8 hexproof ultimate, but needs setup.

cards.name: Mind Meanderer
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
This creature has vigilance as long as you control a Jace planeswalker.
When this creature enters, it fights up to one target creature an opponent controls. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
cards.note: 6-mana 4/4 flier that fights on ETB is a solid two-for-one, though slow and only kills small creatures.

cards.name: Tam's Resistance
cards.oracle_text:
Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn.
Empower Jace 4. (Put four loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: 2 mana for counter, vigilance, and a card back fits great in prowess decks that want cheap cantrips.

cards.name: Afterthought Sentry
cards.oracle_text:
{2}: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
Whenever this creature attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
cards.note: Clunky 2/2 with an expensive flying activation, though exiling graveyard cards on attack has minor upside.

cards.name: Archive Arbiter
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Destroy target noncreature, nonland permanent.
• You gain 4 life.
cards.note: 6-mana 4/4 flyer that either gains 4 life or destroys a noncreature nonland permanent, a solid top-end 2-for-1.

cards.name: Eye of Jace
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1. Then if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, sacrifice this artifact, it deals 2 damage to each opponent, and you gain 2 life. (To surveil 1, look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
cards.note: 1-mana artifact that surveils each turn and eventually sacrifices for damage and life; best in surveil/graveyard decks.

cards.name: Keeper of the Quiet Hour
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, empower Jace 2. (Put two loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
cards.note: 3/2 for 3 that empowers a planeswalker by 2 on entry, solid for a colorless common.

cards.name: Living Library
cards.oracle_text: {6}, Sacrifice this creature: Choose target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls. Its owner shuffles it into their library.
cards.note: Both agree the sacrifice-bounce ability needs too many specific artifact/2-drop synergies to ever matter; effectively unplayable, no letter grade given.

cards.name: Medic's Kitesail
cards.oracle_text:
Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has flying and "Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 1 life."
Equip {2} ({2}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)
cards.note: Cheap equipment giving +1/+0, flying, and lifegain on attack; a fringe playable that can quietly pull weight.

cards.name: Murmuring Volume
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{2}, {T}, Discard a card: Draw a card.
cards.note: Mana rock that can also loot, but unclear which archetype actually wants a colorless ramp-and-filter artifact.

cards.name: Traxos, Scourge Eternal
cards.oracle_text:
Trample
Traxos doesn't untap during your untap step.
Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell, untap Traxos.
cards.note: 4-mana 5/4 trample that untaps whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell, trivially easy to keep active.

cards.name: Fatehold Annex
cards.oracle_text:

{T}: Add {W} or {U}.
cards.note: Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker, a cycle land that's about average value like most fixing lands.

cards.name: Hexhaven Dueling Arena
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}, {T}: Target creature that attacked this turn becomes prepared. Activate only as a sorcery. (Only creatures with prepare spells can become prepared.)

cards.name: Room of Refuge
cards.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color.
{T}: Add one mana of the chosen color.
{5}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.note: Enters tapped for any color with no shuffling, plus a late-game sac ability to add +1/+1 counters.
